# fx · LedoCorp · for LLMs and agents

> Canonical public docs for the fx systems language (package version 0.8.0).
> Package: https://github.com/ledocorp/fxlang (Apache-2.0)
> Full as-implemented inventory: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/surface/ · repo `docs/SURFACE.md`
> Composition method: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/composition/ · Tracking: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/tracking/
> Release notes: package `docs/releases/0.8.0.md` (GitHub Release when tagged)

## Product

- Home: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/
- Pitch: explicit systems language; named regions + effects; **IR → native by default**; dual emission to readable C; wrap/host with C main
- Not a GC language; not a batteries-included app platform
- Surface: numeric tower, ownership/borrows, Result/?, structs/enums/match, generics (no traits), Vec/arrays/`&[T]`/`&mut [T]`/Map/StrBuilder/Buf, modules, extern "c"
- Also: sub-slices `a[lo..hi]`, Map dense iterate (`map_nth_*`), `Map<string,string>` (`map_new_ss`), grow ergonomics, Vec `v[i]` **reads**, `vec_set` slot writes, array-backed `&mut [T]`, `std/pool` + typed **`Id`**, `map_add_i32` / `std/map.add_i32`, `lib/ring_queue` for `std/queue`
- Week-two tools: `examples/tool_{files,bytes,tally,text,result}`
- Composition patterns: `examples/pattern_{ids,mut_table,grow_freeze,ring,pool}`
- Composition examples: `examples/composition_tally`, `examples/composition_reach`
- Dogfood: `examples/dogfood_{chip8,jsonget,chip8_ui,fxjson,textdiff}`

## Package (source of binaries and examples)

- https://github.com/ledocorp/fxlang
- Quick path: put package `bin/` on PATH → `fx doctor` → `fx new hello` → `cd hello` → `fx run main.fx` (exit 42)
- zspec/libzspec resolve from the package beside `bin/` (not only cwd) — keep `bin/`, `zspec/`, `build/` together
- Also in repo: docs/ (incl. SURFACE.md, COMPOSITION.md, TRACKING.md, releases/), scaffolds/, std/, lib/, examples/, zspec/, compiler-source/ (read-only), llms.txt

## As of 0.8.0 — can / cannot (agents)

**Can:** IR → native by default (`fx run` / `fx build`); emit-C path (`--emit-c` / `fx emit-c`); named regions + effects; value-thread grow (`vec_push` / map / buf / strbuf); Vec `v[i]` **reads**; `vec_set` for **slot** writes; arrays + `&mut [T]` write-through; Result/`?`; Map ss; Buf/Bytes; sub-slices; typed **`Id`** via `std/pool`; **`map_add_i32`** accumulate; wrap/host C; dogfood tools under `examples/dogfood_*`.

**Cannot / do not invent:** `v[i] = x` on growable `Vec`; GC; traits; closures; generic maps beyond documented shapes; advanced fx Runtime; Neuton; an `unsafe` dialect.

**Compose hard programs:** ids into region storage (`pattern_ids` / `pattern_pool` / **`composition_reach`**); Map tallies with `map.add_i32` (`tool_tally` / **`composition_tally`**); fixed tables via `&mut [T]` (`pattern_mut_table`); grow-then-freeze-by-convention (`pattern_grow_freeze`). Do **not** reach for Rust interior mut as the default model.

## Generation hints

- Prefer `effects { alloc, mut }` + `region r = arena(n)` for heap work; `io` when using std/io
- Value-thread growers: `v = vec_push(v, x)` / `m = map_insert(...)` / `m = map.add_i32(m, k, d)` / `b = strbuf_push(...)` / `b = buf_push(...)`
- Vec: read with `vec_get` or `v[i]`; **no** `v[i] = x` — grow via `vec_push` / reassign; **slot write** via `vec_set(v, i, x)` (requires `mut`); arrays + `&mut [T]` for write-through views
- Pool: `std/pool` + `lib/id_pool` — handles are typed **`Id`** (bare `i32` at get/set is a type error); `set` uses `vec_set` (stable slot); `raw` / `from_raw` unwrap/wrap explicitly
- Map accumulate: `map_add_i32` / `std/map.add_i32` on `Map<string, i32>` only (slot add or insert)
- `&mut [T]`: index write-through on **array-backed** slices only (not `&mut Vec`)
- Graphs/IR: store nodes in pool/Vecs; edges are **ids**, not escaping interior pointers — see `composition_reach`
- Map iterate: `map_nth_key` / `map_nth_value` (table order); shapes `string → i32` and `string → string` (`map_new_ss` / `*_ss`)
- Prefer `Result` + `?` (no Option); `using core;` for Err/core_Err — general emit works (see `examples/tool_result`)
- Text path: StrBuilder → `write_file` → `str_byte_at` → Buf/Bytes (`examples/tool_text`)
- Use `fx check` / `fx run` (IR → native by default); `fx run --emit-c` for the C path; inspect C with `fx emit-c` (annotate comments by default)
- Tracking: `fx emit-c --debug-source` → `.fxmap` + `#line`; `fx locate --c-file … --line …`; see TRACKING.md
- For C interop: `extern "c" { … }`, `fx bind header.h --out stubs.fx` (Level 1), and/or `fx run lib.fx --host host.c` / `--link extra.c`
- Stay within documented surface (SURFACE.md); follow scaffolds, week-two tools, `pattern_*`, and `composition_*` examples
- There is **no unsafe path**; do not invent one.

## Out of scope on this site

- Internal roadmaps / private research trees
- Advanced fx Runtime (device/caps/migration) — deferred, not current package
- Neuton / Experimental horizon
- LedoCorp monetization (not documented here)
